mode: independent read-only source audit; no builds/tests

gaps.title: Writer metrics are a disconnected value object, not observations of the Store writer
gaps.criterion: P03 step3: Expose writer depth, transaction latency
gaps.reason: Exact-source repository search finds WriterHealthMetrics and record_turn only in writer.rs and its manual integration fixture. Inner/Writer have no metrics state, enqueue/dequeue do not count depth, and Writer::run/transactions do not time or expose actual work. Public engine/WAL helpers also have no live Store request path and the diagnostics test opens a separate connection after dropping Store.
gaps.smallest_root_owned_repair: Instrument the real bounded admission/dequeue path and transaction boundaries with shared bounded counters/monotonic timing; expose a read-only health snapshot plus linked-engine diagnostics from the owning writer connection. Preserve serialization and prevent health reads from opening a competing writer.
required_tests: Drive real Store work and assert completed turns and measured latency advance.
Hold a deterministic writer barrier, enqueue concurrent requests, assert depth/high-water/backpressure and drain; no manual metrics.record_turn substitutes.
Assert real owning-connection WAL/FULL/FK/source identity through the Store health seam.

gaps.title: PASSIVE checkpoint busy flag is incorrectly reported as reader blockage
gaps.reason: PASSIVE checkpoints may succeed while leaving reader-pinned frames uncheckpointed. A busy result can also reflect a competing checkpoint lock; it is not a reader identity signal. The current boolean can report false for a pinned reader and true for an unrelated checkpoint lock. Source SQLite documentation in the locked cached header describes both behaviors.
gaps.smallest_root_owned_repair: Separate checkpoint busy/incomplete/lag from known reader state, preserve unavailable/unknown inspection results instead of coercing negative sentinels to healthy zeroes, and expose meaningful reader/checkpoint observations through G01. Do not label busy!=0 as proof of a reader.
required_tests: Hold a real reader snapshot across subsequent commits; assert incomplete checkpoint/retained frames are visible, then release and observe progress.
Cover competing checkpoint lock and non-WAL/unavailable results without claiming healthy reader state.

gaps.title: Task filters have bounded output but unbounded global scan and snapshot cost
gaps.criterion: P03 step3: indexed bounded queries; MASTER_PLAN6.2 bounded read queues and short-lived reads
gaps.reason: Only after_task_id uses the BTreeMap index. project_id/state/owner are post-filters over all later tasks. matching.next() may traverse the whole collection even for limit1 or no matches; has_more repeats that scan. A caller first obtains a full cloned Store snapshot, so a small page still scales with the global projection. Event keyset and scoped inbox indexes are implemented; this finding is specifically the new filtered task-query seam.
gaps.smallest_root_owned_repair: Add a Store-owned indexed filtered task page seam (maintained secondary indexes or explicit indexed SQL projection) using stable keys/cursor and a scan bound, avoiding a full global snapshot per bounded read. Preserve event/recovery cursor coherence and immutable task source.
required_tests: Large interleaved foreign-project/state/owner population with rare/no-match filter, instrument examined keys/rows and prove bounded work.
Check multi-page order, no duplicate/omitted rows, changed generation and updates after append/rebuild.

gaps.title: Planned migration families are not established by the component schema initialization
gaps.criterion: P03 step1: Create ordered migration families in MASTER_PLAN
gaps.reason: The actual numbered list is foundation/outbox/atomic_effects/context_renders/attention_journal/work_order_intake/intake_capture/usage_observations/admission_reservations/inference_slots; schema user_version remains1, and other coordination/custody DDL is inline. This is working additive component storage, not the six centrally ordered foundation/coordination/evidence-assets/economics/operations/improvement families required by the packet. A different filename alone is not a runtime defect; the missing canonical family/order/version contract is the actual criterion gap.
gaps.smallest_root_owned_repair: Root centralizes the existing DDL under a canonical ordered migration/family registry with a durable schema transition/compatibility policy, preserving already-shipped additive files and data; move/reconcile inline component DDL deliberately. Do not rename immutable historical migrations or implement future provider behavior merely to change filenames.
required_tests: Fresh creation and supported historical database upgrade reach the same schema inventory/version.
Partial migration failure rolls back or resumes deterministically; newer/unsupported schemas fail closed.
Migration/schema identity verification covers required indexes, constraints and immutable associations.

gaps.title: Backup verifier accepts an invented schema_user_version and omits projection/event-version metadata
gaps.criterion: P03 step4 and MASTER_PLAN6.5: backup metadata binds actual schema/event versions
gaps.reason: Creation reads actual PRAGMA user_version, but verification only checks that the manifest value is positive and never compares it with the file. The manifest does not retain Snapshot.schema_version or an explicit event-version contract, despite the referenced backup metadata requirement. File hash/cursor/projection checks do not bind a separately changed manifest field.
gaps.smallest_root_owned_repair: Read and compare the actual backup schema metadata during verification; version the closure metadata deliberately to bind actual projection/event contract versions while preserving existing consumers. Keep closure inventory as an explicit interface and restore authorityfalse.
required_tests: Actual v1 and native v2 snapshots retain their exact projection/event-version metadata through backup verification.
Tampered cursor/digest/size/restore flag fail without claiming restoration authority.

gaps.title: A single process-kill scenario and SQL-error fixtures do not implement the required crash-point matrix
gaps.criterion: P03 Pass: crash-point matrix loses no acknowledged control/usage fact
gaps.reason: The named crash harness exercises one acknowledged TaskSubmitted plus one raw uncommitted row. It does not kill at Store event/outbox/reservation/watermark/usage commit-versus-reply boundaries or at claimed/completed/unknown outbox persistence boundaries. Meaningful SQL-failure, exact-retry, reopen and backup tests exist, but they are not those abrupt-process crash cases. No actual loss of acknowledged data is asserted by this static audit.
gaps.smallest_root_owned_repair: Extend the existing owned-child crash harness with deterministic bounded barriers at transaction/commit/ACK boundaries, including usage and atomic event/budget/slot/outbox joins. Use fake effect counters and opaque test authorities; do not activate a provider or production controller.
required_tests: Before-commit kill: no partial event/association/reservation/usage row or advanced producer ACK.
After-commit-before-reply kill: exact retry recovers the same original receipt, no duplicate event/effect/debit.
After-reply kill: acknowledged control and usage facts survive.
Claim/complete/unknown outbox boundary kills retain identity/fencing/uncertainty and never automatically redispatch ambiguous work.

later_startup_fix: d1659f4 reduces independent schema commits and tests rollback of two groups; it does not close the six full P03 criteria.
